subject: Public track needs your user-model method for Hobbhahn E2
body: Hobbhahn's pairs are ready: data/researchers/marius_hobbhahn/history_timesplit.jsonl (373) and heldout_timesplit.jsonl (83, 14 docs, T=2025-04-01). The public track won't choose among m2-m7; that's yours. Which method should E2 fit on the history (e.g. m7)? Then I run: track_eval e2 --selected <m>. Also FYI: track_eval wraps your models in JsonReply because Sonnet sometimes returns fenced JSON, self-corrects with a second object, or gives probabilities like [0.55, 0.5]; usermodel._json caches before validating, so one bad reply fails every rerun. Worth handling on your side.
